replication.label: Successful
replication.definition: The central finding is recorded as replicated, based on the replication report.

replication.label: Failed
replication.definition: The central finding is recorded as not replicated, following FLoRA’s coding rules.

replication.label: Mixed
replication.definition: The report contains a mixture of replication results, recorded as mixed.

replication.label: Statistically successful but flawed
replication.definition: Statistical success is recorded with a qualification about flaws.

replication.label: Descriptive only
replication.definition: Descriptive results are recorded without a success or failure verdict.

replication.label: Uninformative
replication.definition: The outcome is recorded as uninformative; no successful, failed or mixed verdict is supplied.

replication.label: Unrecognised outcome
replication.definition: A recorded value falls outside the supported vocabulary; see the source outcome.

computational.label: Reproduced
computational.definition: The original numerical results were reproduced.

computational.label: Computational issues
computational.definition: Problems were recorded in reproducing the numerical results.

computational.label: Technical failure
computational.definition: A technical failure was recorded during numerical reproduction.

computational.label: Not checked
computational.definition: The record explicitly says this dimension was not checked.

computational.label: Missing verdict
computational.definition: No verdict is recorded for this dimension.

computational.label: Unrecognised verdict
computational.definition: A recorded value falls outside the supported vocabulary.

robustness.label: Robust
robustness.definition: The findings held under the alternative analyses assessed.

robustness.label: Robustness challenges
robustness.definition: The alternative analyses assessed challenged the findings.

robustness.label: Not checked
robustness.definition: The record explicitly says this dimension was not checked.

robustness.label: Missing verdict
robustness.definition: No verdict is recorded for this dimension.

robustness.label: Unrecognised verdict
robustness.definition: A recorded value falls outside the supported vocabulary.

units.Reference pair: One database row linking an original report to a replication or reproduction report. Reports can occur in several reference pairs.
units.Distinct originals: Original reports counted once within the stated selection, using the available identifiers.
units.Replication report / Reproduction report: The report linked to the original in a reference pair.
units.Citing works: Distinct later works citing the specified report within the stated period.
units.Citation links: Links from citing works to cited reports; one citing work can contribute several links.
